data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 歌词本上的记号
data.description: 排练室里，雪菜用铅笔在歌词旁做了个记号，又低声把那一句唱了一遍。
data.action: seated at a table, marking lyrics with a pencil
data.promptProse: Curled up on a folding chair in an empty school music club room, Setsuna uses a wooden pencil to underline poignant lyric lines in an open notebook, softly mouthing the words to herself. Golden late-afternoon sunlight pours through dusty classroom windows, illuminating chalk dust, acoustic guitar cases, and the deep, earnest devotion in her brown eyes.
